_agi_canonical.title: SOL Sweep-Resilient Deleveraging
_agi_canonical.bar: Autonomous strategy synthesis across a discontinuous sweep state, an upside mandate, and post-sweep carry; public constraints determine the policy without concealed labels.
_agi_canonical.derivation: A hedge of 3,000 leaves the mandated 2,000 SOL while falling below the 3,200-SOL sweep trigger. The stated formula is hedge PnL (-9,000) plus execution cost (+340.80) plus residual stress (-26,000), so stress_loss is -34,659.20 or -23.90290% of $145,000 original margin. Funding credit is 270.
